Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, please arrive at least **15 minutes** before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in.

## First-Time Competitors:
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) for a basic overview of the rules.

## Implementation of 4-Pad
The World Cube Association has announced that as of January 2nd, 2027, all timed attempts must use a Speed Stacks G5 StackMat™ Pro Timer in 4-pad mode, as opposed to the previous 2-pad mode. This competition will be the first in Alberta to do so. You can read the WCA's announcement [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/adoption-of-4-pad-timing-august-2026).

## 본 대회는 3x3x3 큐브 종목을 진행하지 않습니다.
## 4-패드 방식 도입
WCA는 2027년 1월 2일부터 모든 공식 기록 측정 시도에 대해 기존의 2-패드 모드 대신 스피드 스택스 G5 StackMat™ Pro Timer의 4-패드 모드를 사용해야 한다고 발표했습니다. 이번 대회는 대한민국에서 최초로 4-패드 방식을 도입하는 대회가 될 예정입니다. WCA의 공식 발표는 [이곳](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/adoption-of-4-pad-timing-august-2026)에서 확인하실 수 있습니다.

WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaTemplate2099#66188-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaTemplate2099#66187-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인해 주십시오.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2) 및 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 경우 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원활한 기록 측정 및 대회 진행을 위해 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청해 주십시오.

원활한 스태프 업무 수행을 위해 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청해 주십시오.

---

## There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition.
## Implementation of 4-Pad
The World Cube Association has announced that as of January 2nd, 2027, all timed attempts must use a Speed Stacks G5 StackMat™ Pro Timer in 4-pad mode, as opposed to the previous 2-pad mode. This competition will be the first in Republic of Korea to do so. You can read the WCA's announcement [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/adoption-of-4-pad-timing-august-2026).

If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaTemplate2099#66188-for-new-competitors) and [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaTemplate2099#66187-frequently-asked-questions) tabs before registering.

All competitors are strongly encouraged to familiarize themselves with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

In accordance with WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to perform staff duties when requested by the organization team.

Please watch the [competitor tutorial video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to familiarize yourself with the competition procedures.

Please watch the [staff tutorial video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to familiarize yourself with staff duties.
